x-ringi-server: The operations of the framework, which no package's openapi.json has: the administration's, the attachments', and the list of a kind's requests. The server serves them merged with its packages' at GET /openapi.json

get.summary: The kinds with a version the person may switch

200.description: Switched: the record (null when nothing changed) and the kind

get.summary: The latest snapshot of the organization in short

post.summary: Read the organization's data from the source or an upload, check it, and keep it as a draft

200.description: The draft and its difference from the latest snapshot

400.description: A body that does not read, or data that does not pass its checks

get.summary: A draft of the person's, with its difference from the latest snapshot now

200.description: Imported: the record (null when nothing changed) and the organization

get.summary: A page of the record, the newest first

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: the ID of the line the page goes on after

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: how many lines: 1 to 100 (50 if not given)

200.description: The lines, and whether more follow

get.summary: The same lines as CSV; Link names the next part

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: the ID of the line the page goes on after

post.summary: Keep a file to attach to a request

get.summary: A file the person kept, before a request holds it

The requests of a kind the person sees for the kind: the tickets of the versions of the kind whose tickets the gate lets them see whoever is on them (see, asked of the version with no ticket), each one they may see, the newest first, by when they were made, and the larger ID first (the later one) where that is the same. A person the gate lets see none of them gets an empty list

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The kind of request, by its name

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Keeps the tickets of one status; all when it is left out

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many tickets: 1 to 100 (50 if not given)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The ID of the last ticket of the page before: the page goes on after it

get.summary: A file a ticket holds, to a person who may see the ticket
The bundles the person may upload or decide, the newest first

parameters.name: hidden
parameters.description: true lists the hidden bundles too

post.summary: Upload a bundle: check it, and keep it for another administrator to decide

200.description: The bundle and its difference from the server's versions (same: whether it was kept already)

400.description: A body that does not read, or a bundle that does not pass its checks

get.summary: A bundle, and its difference from the server's versions

post.summary: Approve a bundle another administrator uploaded: the server serves it at once

400.description: A body that does not read, or a bundle that does not pass its checks

post.summary: Decline a bundle another administrator uploaded
Hide a bundle: no longer listed, and its archive forgotten when no ticket uses it

framework.error.description: An operation not carried out, and why

framework.refused.description: An operation refused by the state: what changed since it was asked, in English and in Japanese

framework.problems.description: The organization's data that does not pass its checks: the first 100 problems, each at its file and line, how many more there are, and whether the checks stopped at 1,000

admin.start.description: When a version starts: as its description says, from a time, from a day, or never; at and day are null where it has none. number counts the switches

start.description: now, never, description, or a day written YYYY-MM-DD

admin.line.description: A line of the record: a move of a ticket, with the lines of history it made; or a record of a switch, a bundle or an import, with what it changed

admin.organization.description: The latest snapshot of the organization in short, and whether the server has a source to read it from

admin.draft.description: The organization's data checked and kept as the person's draft, and its difference from the latest snapshot

admin.check.description: Read the data from the server's source

items.description: A ticket, as the schema ticket of the packages' openapi.json describes it: as get_ticket and list_mine answer it

more.description: Whether the list holds tickets after the last of the page: the next page is read with that ticket's ID as before

file.kept.description: A file kept: its ID, which a form's field holds, its name and type as given, its size in bytes, and where to read it

admin.bundle_act.description: Who did it (null for the server, as it started), when (Unix seconds) and why

digest.description: names the difference: an approval names the one it was decided on

api_changes.description: whether a version the bundle adds changes the API: its approval says it knows (api_changes: true)

script_changes.description: whether the script the kinds' pages load (a2ui/functions.js) changes: its approval says it was read (script_changes: true)

tools_changes.description: whether the descriptions of the kinds' tools (mcp/tools.json) change: the approval says they were read (tools_changes: true)

screens_changes.description: whether the kinds' screens change: the approval says they were read (screens_changes: true)

against.description: the version it is compared with: the highest below it the server has (null for none)

new.description: a kind the server does not have

script_changes.description: whether the script the kinds' pages load (a2ui/functions.js) changes: its approval says it was read (script_changes: true)

tools_changes.description: whether the descriptions of the kinds' tools (mcp/tools.json) change: the approval says they were read (tools_changes: true)

screens_changes.description: whether the kinds' screens change: the approval says they were read (screens_changes: true)

said.description: what the bundle says the version changes (ritsu's `ringi diff`): against which version, of which bundle (its digest; null for none)

admin.bundle_difference.description: What a bundle changes: of each version it adds, the difference from the version below it, as the server makes it and as the bundle says it

source.description: uploaded, or read from the server's directory of bundles as it started

signed.description: whether a key the server takes signed it

key.description: the fingerprint of the key that signed the bundle (empty for none)

key_listed.description: whether the process lists the key that signed it now

ritsu.description: the version of ritsu the bundle's wasm.json names; empty for one it does not name

kinds.description: how many vectors of each kind the check ran, of a ticket's first event (starts) and of the events after it (nexts)

checks.description: how many vectors of the events and of the forms ran on its code and agreed

holds.description: the versions it holds that the server has, alike

same.description: of an upload: whether the store kept the bundle already

admin.bundle.description: A bundle: a version of a kind, or a new kind, added to the running server

signed.description: whether the server takes only signed bundles

digest.description: the digest of the difference the approval was decided on

api_changes.description: true: the approver knows the bundle changes the API

script_changes.description: whether the script the kinds' pages load (a2ui/functions.js) changes: its approval says it was read (script_changes: true)

tools_changes.description: whether the descriptions of the kinds' tools (mcp/tools.json) change: the approval says they were read (tools_changes: true)

screens_changes.description: whether the kinds' screens change: the approval says they were read (screens_changes: true)

framework.bad.description: The body, the query or the key does not read

framework.cross_site.description: A browser sent it with a page of another site open

framework.not_found.description: No such thing, or the person may not see it or do it

framework.too_large.description: The body is larger than the server takes

framework.media_type.description: The body is not of a type the operation takes

framework.too_many.description: Too many at once, or too many in a day: try again after Retry-After

framework.refused.description: Refused by the state: what changed since it was asked

framework.key.name: Idempotency-Key
framework.key.description: 1 to 255 bytes of visible ASCII: the same key answers the same, and does nothing again

admin.bundle.name: digest
admin.bundle.description: the bundle's digest: the SHA-256 of its archive, 64 digits of lowercase hexadecimal

admin.bundle_signature.name: Bundle-Signature
admin.bundle_signature.description: the bundle's signature, the content of the file `ringi-bundle sign` writes: required when the server takes only signed bundles
